records.name: OpenQR — Free QR Code Generator
records.tagline: Create beautiful, QR codes instantly. Unlimited and Free.
records.description: Free QR Code Generator Online. Create custom QR codes with colors, logos, SVG, PNG & PDF. No signup, no watermark, unlimited & professional.

records.name: Solo Slack
records.tagline: Management tool for Indie hackers & solopreneurs. Fully OS
records.description: A self-hosted productivity workspace with Markdown notes and Kanban boards — built for solo makers who don't need the noise. -imshreekumarOPS/soloslack

records.name: Glint
records.tagline: AI visual supports for special education in seconds
records.description: Become a visual superhero in minutes. Glint is the #1 AI-powered visual supports generator — create communication boards, visual schedules, and social stories in seconds. Powering 300,000+ learners.

records.name: The Jazz Map
records.tagline: A century of musical connections
records.description: I still remember the moment I realised John Coltrane had played in Miles Davis’ band. It kind of blew my mind that two of the greatest musicians ever were just on stage together night after night, sometimes to rooms of only 20–30 people. That sent me down a rabbit hole, and I started to notice how interconnected the whole world of jazz is: bands, sidemen, collaborations, mentorship, influence. Every great player seems to lead you to another. So I built this as a way to explore that visually.

records.name: My ideal candidate
records.tagline: AI that reads CVs so you don't have to
records.description: Stop wasting hours on CVs that were never going to make it. Myidealcandidate uses AI to score and rank candidates against your exact criteria instantly. Paste a JD, upload CVs, get a ranked shortlist with explanations. Free, no login, GDPR compliant.d CVs, define your criteria, and let AI rank candidates in seconds. No signup required.

records.name: Premium Estates CRM
records.tagline: Close more deals with a smarter CRM
records.description: A modern CRM platform to capture, nurture, and convert leads seamlessly. With automation, pipeline tracking, and real-time insights, Premium Estates CRM empowers teams to boost productivity and drive consistent growth.

records.name: ChatTrack
records.tagline: Find, navigate & export ChatGPT and Gemini chats instantly
records.description: ChatTrack solves one of the most frustrating problems with AI chats — losing important answers in long conversations. 🔍 Instantly navigate to any prompt 📄 Export clean PDFs in 1 click ⚡ Performance mode reduces lag in long chats ⭐ Bookmark important questions 🔒 100% local storage (no data leaves your device) Built for students, researchers & developers who rely on ChatGPT and Gemini daily.

records.name: Paint My Emotion
records.tagline: Turn how you feel into abstract art
records.description: Paint My Emotion turns how you’re feeling into a unique abstract painting. Record a voice memo or type your thoughts. AI captures the emotion behind your words and generates a one-of-a-kind painting, plus an artist statement that explains it back to you. No prompts. No design skills. Just speak honestly. Feel it. Paint it. Keep it.

records.name: Astrovya
records.tagline: Birth charts & AI readings — all in one place.
records.description: Get your personalized birth chart, deep insights, and instant answers powered by AI. From career and love to life decisions, understand your future with clarity. Fast, intelligent, and designed for real guidance.

records.name: MojCV
records.tagline: The Actually Free CV Builder - No subscriptions.
records.description: MojCV is a CV builder that’s actually free — no subscriptions, no locked downloads, and no tricks. Most resume builders let you create a CV for free, then charge when you try to download it. MojCV removes that completely. You can create, customize, and download unlimited CVs as high-quality PDFs without paying or signing up. Choose from professional templates, fill in your details, and get a clean, job-ready CV in minutes. Everything is designed to work out of the box — no formatting, no hassle.

records.name: E-commerce Platform (Shopify Killer)
records.tagline: E-commerce Solution #DigitalProducts #WebScripts
records.description: Launch your online business with ready-to-use tools and a complete e-commerce solution. No monthly fees! One-time purchase includes everything.

records.name: NovaDreamApp
records.tagline: Automate your Instagram DMs in 5 minutes. No flowcharts.
records.description: NovaDreamApp is Instagram DM automation built for small business owners who are tired of answering the same questions all day. Connect your Instagram in one click, set up auto-reply rules for common questions (pricing, shipping, address), and let an AI assistant handle the rest. It learns your business and responds naturally. No flowcharts. No complex workflows. Currently in beta. Sign up to get early access.

records.name: Agenbase AI
records.tagline: automate your workflow with stunning AI agents
records.description: 7 plug-and-play n8n AI agents that run your business on autopilot. Generate leads, write cold emails, post daily content, repurpose YouTube videos, track finance signals, and publish SEO blogs — all without writing a single line of code. One workflow JSON. Drop it into n8n. Done. 🔥 Full bundle of 7 agents for just $25 — 58% off individual pricing.

records.name: Habit Fusion Tracker
records.tagline: Build habits that stick — with streaks, reminders
records.description: HabitFusion helps you build better habits with streak tracking and daily reminders. Free on iPhone and iPad.

records.name: RetirePro.io
records.tagline: Simple Retirement Planning
records.description: The Problem Most retirement calculators lie to you. They assume the market returns exactly 7% every year. But we all know that's not how it works — 2008 happened, 2020 happened, and markets are unpredictable. That's why financial advisors (who charge $300/hour) use Monte Carlo simulations instead. They run thousands of "what if" scenarios to show you the real probability you won't run out of money. We built that — and made it free.

records.name: OWL
records.tagline: Your AI that never sleeps. Discovers what you're missing.
records.description: OWL is an open-source AI daemon that watches your Gmail, Calendar, GitHub, Slack, Shopify, and files in the background. It builds a knowledge graph of everyone and everything you interact with, then discovers patterns you'd never notice. "Your biggest client filed 3 support tickets the same week their renewal arrived." Runs 100% locally with Ollama — no API keys, no cloud, no cost. Your data never leaves your machine. Try it: npx owl-ai demo MIT licensed. Node.js + SQLite.

records.name: Trenchy.fun
records.tagline: Built in the trenches. For the trenches.
records.description: Trenchy.Fun is the all-in-one command center for Solana degens and trenchers. Launch tokens on Pump.fun or Bags.fm in seconds from Telegram or Discord — no websites, no wallets, no friction. Track the market with real-time ecosystem signals and the TrenchScreener. Then plug into the Trencher Social Network: profiles, feeds, DMs, bounties, leaderboards, and a token-gated VIP lounge — all driven by your $TRENCHY balance.

records.name: PDF Compressor – Reduce Size
records.tagline: Compress & resize PDF offline — no cloud, no sign-in
records.description: PDF files too large to email or share on WhatsApp? PDF Compressor lets you shrink any PDF on your Android device — no internet, no cloud upload, files never leave your phone. 🔒 100% Offline 📦 Compress PDF to 150KB, 200KB or 500KB 📐 Resize & reduce PDF size in KB & MB 🔗 Merge & split PDFs ✅ No sign-in. No watermark. Perfect for students, professionals & anyone who needs to compress PDF for WhatsApp, email or upload limits.

records.name: Arcform
records.tagline: Turn any idea into a build blueprint in 30 seconds
records.description: Arcform turns your raw idea into a full build blueprint in seconds. → Phase 1: AI asks smart questions to understand your idea → Phase 2: Recommends Automation, App, or Hybrid approach → Phase 3: Step-by-step plan with tools, timeline & risks PDF · Markdown · JSON export · Free to start Perfect for founders, freelancers & indie hackers.

records.name: Nomie
records.tagline: AI wellness app that turns doomscrolling into self‑care
records.description: We’re building an AI wellness app that transforms doomscrolling into intentional self-care. Nomie is for people who feel overwhelmed, stressed, or mentally drained by constant screen time. Instead of asking users to disconnect, it redirects scrolling habits into guided resets, breathing exercises, journaling, and emotional support. We solve the problem of compulsive digital consumption by turning screen time into a tool for calm, focus, and regulation.

records.name: gollok.com
records.tagline: gollok
records.description: Welcome to Gollok.com, your go-to platform for global news, daily tools, education resources, financial updates, and trending topics. Whether you need the latest business news, sports highlights, entertainment buzz, or free educational PDFs, we’ve got you covered. Stay informed with our digital newspaper, world nation calendar, and tech-travel guides—all in one place!

records.name: Nerveless
records.tagline: Practice social situations stress-free
records.description: Practice difficult social situations with an AI trainer. A safe environment for developing communication skills.

records.name: Traspion
records.tagline: AI Powered Transcription, Translation, and Subtitles
records.description: Transform your audio and video content with AI-powered transcription. Get translation and subtitles included at no extra cost. 95%+ accuracy | 100+ languages supported.

records.name: SerisLab
records.tagline: The Portfolio that evolves with you.
records.description: Most dev portfolios are abandoned weeks after launch. SerisLab fixes that. Connect your GitHub or upload your resume and AI turns it into a living portfolio — writing things like "Reduced deployment time by 60% for 10,000 users" instead of "Used React and Docker." Same work, a completely different story. Auto-sync keeps it current every time you push. No design skills, no copywriting, no maintenance. Under 3 minutes to launch.

records.name: Furnea
records.tagline: AI Furniture Commerce Engine for brands
records.description: Furnea is an AI platform for furniture and home decor brands. It helps turn a single product photo into high-quality catalog images, interior scenes and marketing content. With Furnea you can: • Generate 3000+ interior scenes instantly • Show products inside real customer homes (Room Maker) • Swap fabrics and materials on products • Turn product images into videos Furnea is built to help furniture brands reduce production costs and increase conversion rates.

records.name: Aurify Marketing
records.tagline: AI-Powered Marketing That Turns Traffic Into Revenue
records.description: Your Revenue Growth Partner for SEO, AI Search & Performance Marketing : A Leading AI SEO Agency We help businesses dominate Google rankings, generate qualified leads, and scale revenue using advanced digital marketing strategies. As a results-driven AI SEO agency, we deliver smart, data-powered AI SEO services that improve visibility, boost conversions, and accelerate sustainable […]

records.name: FixFace
records.tagline: AI skin retouching for flawless photos & videos
records.description: AI-powered skin retouching and makeup filters for photos & videos. Remove blemishes, smooth skin, and apply 10+ makeup presets. Try it free in your browser now.

records.name: EmulatorJS
records.tagline: Embed playable retro games on any website instantly
records.description: EmulatorJS lets you embed retro game emulation directly into your website with a few lines of code. Enabled by WebAssembly, it’s open source, browser-based, customizable, multilingual, and built on RetroArch libretro cores.

records.name: Gracias Ai
records.tagline: Ai agent to fasten up iOS app publishing| Audit all policies
records.description: AI-powered iOS App Store compliance auditing. Upload your project and get a comprehensive audit against Apple's Review Guidelines.

records.name: HumanizeAI
records.tagline: Make AI text sound human
records.description: Transform AI-generated text into natural, human-like content. Free online tool to bypass AI detection and humanize your text instantly.

records.name: DecisionsAI
records.tagline: remote control your machine. Voice first AI agent.
records.description: Everyone's building an agent. We get it. So did we. Ours just doesn't need the internet. Voice-first. Privacy-first. Yours-first. Fully offline, fully free. Talk to it, it controls your computer. Open apps, transcribe, automate - all local, all yours. Can even be your Voice. Your Personality. Bring your own keys - works with Anthropic, OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Ollama, Groq, Kilocode and more. No subscriptions, no data collection, no cloud. Just your voice and your computer doing the thing.
